query:
SELECT d.name
            FROM domain d
            JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT det.name
                FROM domain_event de
                JOIN domain_event_type det ON de.event_type_id = det.id
                WHERE de.domain_id = d.id
                ORDER BY de.created_at DESC
                LIMIT 1
            ) latest_event ON true
            WHERE latest_event.name = 'Blocked'
